label: 9 November 2026
title: Flick starts Bernal and Fariñas at the Metropolitano
deck: Marc Bernal replaces the injured Rodri. Brian Fariñas keeps the right-back role. Eric García and Frenkie de Jong start on the bench. Kick-off is 21:00. Barça lead by two points.

stories.headline: Flick starts Bernal for Rodri and keeps Fariñas at right-back
stories.summary: Hansi Flick named Marc Bernal in midfield and Brian Fariñas at right-back for the 21:00 visit to the Metropolitano. Eric García and Frenkie de Jong are on the bench. Joan García, Cubarsí, Gerard Martín and Cancelo complete the back line. Raphinha leads the attack with Yamal and Gordon.
stories.body: The side is Joan García; Fariñas, Cubarsí, Gerard Martín, Cancelo; Bernal, Pedri; Yamal, Fermín, Gordon and Raphinha. It is the only change from the XI that beat Aston Villa 3-0, forced by Rodri’s hamstring. Flick told reporters before the match that Bernal has done a good job and that Fariñas connects well with Yamal. Eric and Christensen travelled after rejoining the group, but neither starts. De Jong is also among the substitutes. Koundé, Olmo, Espart and Bardghji remain out. The squad list was published on the club channels before the flight.

stories.headline: Two points separate Barça and Atlético at the Metropolitano
stories.summary: Barcelona lead La Liga on 30 points. Atlético sit second on 28. A home win for the hosts would put them top before the international break. The match is the last La Liga fixture of 2026 before players report to national teams.
stories.body: Flick called the contest important and said three or four strong teams sit close together. Simeone told the press that Barça is possibly the best side and has no doubt about the talent from midfield forward. The Metropolitano holds a tribute to Jesús de Miguel before kick-off. Raphinha arrives with 19 goals this season. After the match the last international window of the year begins. Barça next face Villarreal at home on 22 November. The referee is Javier Alberola Rojas.

stories.headline: Bernal starts in place of the injured Rodri
stories.summary: Rodri misses the Metropolitano with a minor right hamstring tear sustained against Aston Villa. Flick has chosen Marc Bernal to partner Pedri. De Jong is available on the bench after his own return from injury.
stories.body: The club confirmed the injury after tests earlier in the week. Spanish reports put the absence at three to four weeks, which would also rule Rodri out of Spain’s Nations League fixtures. Bernal started the second half against Villa. Flick said both players are similar and that De Jong is fully fit, but the starting choice fell to the La Masia midfielder. Olmo remains out with an adductor issue. The midfield shape is the same 4-3-3 used in recent matches, with Fermín as the number 10.

tweets.name: Mundo Deportivo
tweets.text: 💬 Flick: "Bernal ha hecho un gran trabajo y Brian conecta bien con Lamine"

stories.headline: Fariñas keeps the right-back role; Eric starts on the bench
stories.summary: Brian Fariñas starts again at right-back. Eric García, who was cleared to start, is among the substitutes along with Andreas Christensen. Koundé remains out with the ankle sprain.
stories.body: Flick has stuck with the shape that worked against Alavés and Aston Villa. Fariñas has covered the right side while Koundé recovers. The French full-back has already missed the Clásico, Alavés and Villa. Christensen’s inclusion on the bench is being managed after nearly two months out. The defensive absences also include Xavi Espart (syndesmosis) and Roony Bardghji. Saturday’s final session included several Barça Atlètic players. The back four is Fariñas, Cubarsí, Gerard Martín and Cancelo.

stories.headline: Raphinha takes 19 goals to the Metropolitano
stories.summary: The captain has 19 goals in 13 matches after scoring twice against Aston Villa. He signed a new deal until 30 June 2030 earlier in the week. Flick expects him to start as the central striker.
stories.body: Raphinha equalled Ronaldinho’s Champions League tally for the club with the two goals on Tuesday. He has 15 in La Liga and four in Europe. He told the media at the signing ceremony that he would like to finish his career at Barcelona if his body allows it. Lamine Yamal and Anthony Gordon complete the front three. Fermín López starts as the number 10. The Brazilian is expected to travel with Ancelotti’s Brazil squad after the match for the friendlies against Japan and Singapore.

stories.headline: Alberola Rojas takes charge of his first Atlético-Barça
stories.summary: Javier Alberola Rojas will officiate the match at the Metropolitano. It is his first Atlético-Barça in the top flight. He has directed Atlético 21 times and Barça 13 times previously.
stories.body: SPORT and Mundo Deportivo confirmed the appointment earlier in the week. Alberola Rojas averages 4.67 yellow cards per La Liga match this season. He recently made his Champions League debut. Javier Iglesias Villanueva is the VAR. Atlético’s record under him is 12 wins, 5 draws and 4 losses. Barça’s record is 10 wins, 2 draws and 1 loss. The match is the last La Liga fixture before the international break.

stories.headline: Barça beat Madrid CFF 5-1 to extend lead to four points
stories.summary: Pere Romeu’s side won 5-1 at the Johan Cruyff with goals from Brugts, Pajor, Carla Julià, Patri Guijarro and Pina. Marta Torrejón reached 500 appearances for the club. Real Madrid drew, so the gap at the top of Liga F is now four points.
stories.body: The match was the last domestic fixture before Thursday’s Champions League meeting with Arsenal at Camp Nou. Romeu rotated several players. Torrejón came on and assisted the third goal on her landmark appearance. Pina scored the fifth. Madrid CFF pulled one back through Konan. The attendance was 2,572. Barça next face Arsenal on 12 November. The result keeps the side clear at the top of the Liga F Moeve table.

stories.headline: Laporta meets Cerezo before the match; Álvarez returns to the starting XI
stories.summary: Joan Laporta arrived with the squad and met Enrique Cerezo. The clubs described relations as good after the summer interest in Julián Álvarez. Álvarez starts for Atlético after missing midweek. Simeone said Barça is possibly the best team.
stories.body: Mundo Deportivo reported that Laporta used the trip to close the chapter on the Álvarez pursuit. The Argentine starts for the hosts alongside Kang-in Lee. Atlético’s XI is Oblak; Llorente, Hancko, Pubill, Grimaldo; Koke, Barrios, Baena; Giuliano, Kang-in and Álvarez. Romero is out for the hosts. Barça fans were heard chanting “Julián is a culé” as they entered the stadium. The match is the final La Liga game before the international window.
